reconciliation_purpose: P1.27 reconciles two evidence gaps identified in P1.26 post-mortem: (1) X1-X10 used non-chat HTTP endpoints — not the Chat Router→Orchestrator→Canary chain; (2) Gate M closure was HTTP 200 only, not DOM/network assertions. P1.27 closes both gaps with real chat soak and Playwright browser E2E.

gap_1_chat_orchestration.description: P1.26 X1-X10 soak windows used GET /health, GET /profile, GET /watchlist, GET /reports etc. None of these routes go through the Chat Router (POST /api/v1/chat/sessions/{sid}/messages). The Canary policy in chat_orchestrator.py's _schedule_pi_official_report_shadow() was never exercised.
gap_1_chat_orchestration.implications: Shadow activation triad (agent_executor_mode=pi_compatible_shadow + pi_agent_shadow_enabled + allowed_agents) was never exercised end-to-end through real HTTP in P1.26
gap_1_chat_orchestration.resolution: P1.27 Y1-Y10 windows use POST /api/v1/chat/sessions/{sid}/messages exclusively

gap_2_gate_m_browser.description: P1.26 Gate M was closed via curl HTTP 200 to 127.0.0.1:18080. No DOM assertions, no JavaScript execution verification, no network tab inspection.
gap_2_gate_m_browser.implications: Frontend JavaScript bundle load, chat interface render, and network isolation were unverified
gap_2_gate_m_browser.resolution: P1.27 Gate Q closes with 30 Playwright browser cases including DOM assertions and network isolation checks

gap_3_backend_suite.description: P1.26 reported 6849 PASS, P1.25 reported 6510 PASS — both excluded 'pre-existing failures'. Root cause: pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 (too old), FastAPI 0.116.1 (too old), missing pypdf/baostock/alembic packages. Not pre-existing test bugs.
gap_3_backend_suite.resolution: P1.27 runs canonical suite with all environment fixes; reports 7027/0/15

p127_evidence_additions.y1_through_y10_chain: HTTP → FastAPI Router → ChatOrchestrator.process_message() → _schedule_pi_official_report_shadow() → asyncio.create_task(_pi_shadow_run()) → PiShadowDiagnosticsSink.record()
p127_evidence_additions.y1_through_y10_query_mix: 50% PDF-intent (年报/季报/PDF keywords matching _OFFICIAL_REPORT_PDF_SHADOW_PATTERN) + 50% general queries
p127_evidence_additions.gate_q_closure_method: Playwright browser + DOM assertions + network isolation

cumulative_totals_updated.note: P1.27 Y1-Y10 adds first real chat HTTP requests to the cumulative evidence record
